name: manual_903245
claim: When a cross-platform infra fix (line endings, encoding, build config) is documented in the wiki, implement it in main the same session — do not leave it as documentation only.

decisions.notes: A wiki page describing the .gitattributes/.editorconfig fix for CRLF/BOM checkout churn was written first, but the actual files weren't added to either repo's main until the user pointed out agents were 're-inventing failed solutions every commit and sync.' Documentation that isn't wired into the repo doesn't stop the next agent from hitting the same problem — only the committed config does. Verified safe to apply immediately in both repos: git add --renormalize . touched 17 files in orama-system and 1 in Perpetua-Tools, all confirmed lossless via git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol (zero semantic change, no binaries touched).
